title: Implement authorized photo upload validation, local storage, and sha256 foundation
verify: Unauthorized upload is denied for missing/revoked PlantAccessGrant, archived normal-flow Plant, invalid session, and disabled membership
Invalid MIME/signature/empty/oversized uploads are rejected before catalog, manifest, timeline, or Bus publication
Accepted upload writes local file with server-generated traversal-safe path and computes sha256
evidence_required: Photo upload validation and sha256 test output
constraints: Validate ActorContext, active membership, active Plant, and PlantAccessGrant before storage authority is accepted
User-supplied filenames are display metadata only after sanitization
File write/checksum failure creates no accepted authoritative catalog state
invariants: Photo upload data is untrusted data, not instruction
Server-generated paths and IDs are authority
Secrets/session/auth material cannot enter filenames, manifests, timeline, Bus, UI Feed, exports, or agent context
